summary.statement: CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE of V58 0%: V58 rendered images are near-white (mean=[0.977,0.977,0.977], std=[0.0028,0.0028,0.0028]). LIBERO images have realistic colors (mean=[0.414,0.371,0.329], std=[0.252,0.247,0.241]). Root cause: empty MTL files — drawerbox geom_*.mtl have no material definitions (only Blender header comments, no Kd/Ka/Ks). PyBullet ER_TINY_RENDERER renders objects without materials as white. CRITICAL CONTEXT: Old dataset (3,305 frames) had CONTINUOUS gripper_joint (std=0.0196, range=[-0.042, +0.001]) — frozen gripper was NOT present. V58 trained on this dataset and STILL got 0%. This proves near-white images (NOT frozen gripper) is the real root cause. Fix: add material definitions to URDF or MTL files, then regenerate images.
summary.display_role_reason: active supporting context but not directly driving the current phase

summary.statement: CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE (one of multiple): V58 images near-white (mean=[0.977,0.977,0.977], std=[0.0028,0.0028,0.0028]). LIBERO images: mean=[0.414,0.371,0.329], std=[0.252,0.247,0.241]. Root cause: empty MTL files (geom_*.mtl have no Kd/Ka/Ks). PyBullet ER_TINY_RENDERER renders without materials -> white. CONTEXT: V58 trained on dataset with CONTINUOUS gripper (std=0.0196) and STILL got 0%. Near-white images (NOT frozen gripper) is confirmed root cause. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: MINT 0% is MULTI-CAUSE. Near-white images are ONE confirmed cause. Remaining factors: teacher demo quality (AnyGrasp physics violations), insufficient training (18K frames/1K steps vs 3B model), state[3:7] format (joint positions vs quaternions). Fix images first, then small-scale validation.

summary.statement: V58 data integrity audit FAILED and root cause priority REFRAMED. (1) New pack FAILED: file-000.parquet CORRUPTED (Parquet magic bytes error — partial write), file-001.parquet MISSING. New pack never completed. (2) Live dataset is OLD dataset (36 episodes, 3,305 frames). (3) Old dataset has CONTINUOUS gripper_joint (std=0.0196, range=[-0.042, +0.001]). Frozen gripper was NOT present in training data. (4) V58 trained on old dataset (with continuous gripper) and STILL got 0% success. CONCLUSION: frozen gripper was NEVER the root cause of V58 0%. P0b (near-white images, mean=0.977, std=0.0028) is the REAL root cause. P0a code fix is correct but irrelevant to V58 failure. PRIORITY: P0b (images) >> P0a (gripper code). NEXT: P0b fix → complete new pack → P1_regenerate → P2_retrain.

summary.statement: V58 dataset had CONTINUOUS gripper_joint — CANCELLED root cause. Evidence: NPZ raw std=0.0208, stats.json std=0.0196. Near-white images confirmed suboptimal (E020, E022). E022: pretrained MINT (never trained on Infinigen images) also gets 0.000 drawer_fraction. This is CONSISTENT WITH multiple hypotheses: (a) white images ARE the bottleneck, (b) action/state mismatch IS the bottleneck, (c) both contribute. NOT YET PROVEN which. E023 (RCA1): teacher demo quality ELIMINATED as root cause for overfit subset (7/7 episodes task-successful). Remaining: RCA2 (action normalization), RCA3 (state representation). P0b (colored reroll): OPEN / UNDECIDED pending RCA2/3.
summary.display_role_reason: active supporting context but not directly driving the current phase

summary.statement: V59 finetuned checkpoint shows better offline action imitation than pretrained on the training subset. Evidence: 200 steps on 494 frames, loss 6.520→3.741 (-42.7%), action RMSE +51.7%, gripper MAE +78.0%. HOWEVER: task-level overfit has NOT been verified in DrawerRobotEnv. No evidence of: (1) drawer success rate in simulation, (2) attach/open sequence correctness, (3) drawer fraction improvement. "Pipeline confirmed" is OVERSTATED — "offline imitation improved" is the accurate claim. Env-level overfit gate (finetuned vs pretrained in env) required before claiming task success.
summary.display_role_reason: active supporting context but not directly driving the current phase

summary.statement: V58 TRAIN-TIME dataset was 18,701 frames / 229 episodes (from v58_train.log: "dataset.num_frames=18701, dataset.num_episodes=229"). Current live dataset/ is 3,305 frames / 36 episodes — this is a RESIDUE from post-training overwrite, NOT what V58 was trained on. The original 18,701/229 dataset was overwritten by an interrupted pack run on Apr 5 13:38. The claim "V58 used corrupt data (3305 frames)" is FALSE. V58 trained on 18,701 frames. V58 failure (0% success) occurred with near-white images (ER_TINY_RENDERER) and continuous gripper_joint. 3305/36 is post-train residue.
summary.display_role_reason: active supporting context but not directly driving the current phase

summary.statement: V59 env-level overfit gate: NEGATIVE_GATE. Both pretrained and finetuned MINT achieve 0.000 drawer_fraction on all 6 simulation rollouts (3 seeds × 2 episodes). Offline action RMSE improvement (+51.7%) does NOT translate to task success. CORRECTED DIAGNOSIS: E023 (RCA1) proved all 7/7 teacher episodes are task-successful (mean_max_drawer=0.989). Teacher demos ARE successful. MINT improved at imitating them offline, but imitated actions still do not open the drawer in simulation. Root cause must be: action normalization mismatch, state representation gap, or sim-to-sim gap (LIBERO→Infinigen). Insufficient training data is NOT the sole cause. Full V59 retrain without fixing action/state contract will repeat V58 failure. P0b (colored reroll): OPEN QUESTION — pretrained failure in white images is consistent with multiple hypotheses.
summary.display_role_reason: active supporting context but not directly driving the current phase

summary.statement: All 7/7 V59 overfit teacher episodes are task-successful. RCA1 verified: episodes 0,1,2,3,4,5,49 (LeRobot indices) map to physics-legal NPZ rollouts with success=True, mean_max_drawer_fraction=0.989, attach_rate=1.0. Teacher quality is NOT the root cause of V58/V59 failure. Root cause must be in MINT training pipeline: action normalization, state representation, or sim-to-sim gap. METHODOLOGY: LeRobot episode_index ≠ NPZ filename episode index. Must trace through V59 pack log sorted file order. E023 confirms.
summary.display_role_reason: active supporting context but not directly driving the current phase

summary.statement:
For the 7 V59 overfit episodes, action normalization is NOT the root cause of
task failure in DrawerRobotEnv. Dataset actions are in [-1, 1] range (position/rotation)
and gripper uses ±1.0 convention, matching DrawerRobotEnv's expected input contract.
Teacher action replay is inconclusive (attachment_local estimation error) but
static analysis independently proves no action format mismatch.

VERIFIED FIXED: P0a completed. dataset_builder._build_libero_state() fix confirmed effective. file-000.parquet verification: gripper_joint std=0.0198, 6,693 unique values, range=[-0.042, +0.001]. Vs OLD LeRobot parquet: std=0.0000, 1 unique value (all = -0.042). NPZ raw data already had healthy continuous values (std=0.0096-0.0834). Root cause was dataset_builder calling _infinigen_to_libero_gripper() on already-continuous values (all < 0.5 → CLOSED=-0.042). Fix: remove incorrect conversion + add LIBERO range clamp.

CANCELLED: P0a gripper_joint fix was correct code engineering but addressed a NON-EXISTENT problem. Live evidence confirms: NPZ raw gripper_joint std=0.0208 (continuous, 40 unique values). stats.json gripper_joint std=0.0196 (continuous, range=[-0.042,+0.001]). V58 dataset had CONTINUOUS gripper_joint throughout — gripper was NEVER frozen. The dataset_builder._build_libero_state() code fix (removed erroneous _infinigen_to_libero_gripper call) was correct engineering but did NOT change the V58 dataset because V58 training happened BEFORE the code fix was committed. V58 0% is NOT caused by frozen gripper.

The earlier strong diagnosis that MINT behaves as an image-only VQ-VAE prior because language-model weights failed to load is contradicted by E033/E034. The key-remap bug is fixed, LM weights load after remapping, and real-LIBERO forward-pass recheck shows mixed nonzero state sensitivity rather than universal state invariance.
